mapper.select: SELECT * FROM friend_request WHERE from_user_id = #{fromUserId} AND to_user_id = #{toUserId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friend_request(from_user_id, to_user_id, message, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{message}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM friend_request WHERE from_user_id = #{userId} OR to_user_id = #{userId}
